unreplied.preview: "It looks like you have the healing well in hand.  I will take my time to refocus and listen to the wind in the trees to regain my center."

Húxiān wanders over to the Atrix Blossom.

"Ahh. I don't know if I should be concerned, grateful, or horrified."

Sighing a little, Quacksalver agrees. 

"Two parts of the last, equal parts of the first two. I do not imagine your mum ever spoke on why she would want this? Seems like she must have hard particular thoughts. Raising the dead might even be on the docket...if this stuff actually works. But whoever works the flower would not have long. Concerned, grateful, and horrified is indeed what I suggest you be. Probably in that order."

"The bloom looses potency in a day when picked. I could try to make something out of it right here. But Inda might be angry if we just use it for anything. All things considered, there's only the one of these out here."
"I'm surprised the spirit was powerful enough to create such a thing... And what an awful way to do so. Poor little leaf, I wonder if they had the blossom within them the entire time?"

"...wait a minute. Atrix Blossom..."

A look of horror crosses the hobgoblin's face. He turns to the other two. He gestures to the nearby body of the woman.

"Did you not call...her... Atrix?"
"The Nith-thing, it seems like a powerful trickster spirit. Perhaps they are trying to be poetic with their works of mischief?"

"No that was Atrix she sent us in this direction.  Well her brother did.  But i think she knew Nith was coming for her.  That is why I was wondering if this could be used to revive her.  Not sure her brother should get the flower themselves.   The other thing there are 4 of us.  You can make 4 tinctures.  Perhaps fate is saying we should keep them to ourselves."

Húxiān chuckles,

"Fate didn't send us here, mother did, and your god-thing. I've tried to get one over on mother a few times, it hasn't gone well a single time yet. I don't particularly favor trying to deprive her of the thing she sent us after."

She kicks a rock into the clear water and crouches down to observe the ripples it makes. After a moment she turns back towards the plant with a covetous gleam to her eyes.

"That said, if you make that into the tincture, I want in. No sense missing ou

The hobgoblin settles beside the plant that was once Leaf. Sitting against his pack, he seems to stare at the flower for a bit before answering.

"I do not think "Fate" is a thing. There is only what you will do, and what you will not. Part of me very much wants to experiment with what this flower might be able to do. Raise a person from the dead. Question said person about if they are indeed a god, and what that means for the future of alchemy if gods themselves can indeed be raised from the de

Húxiān shrugs and starts climbing around on the bigger ruins for fun.

"She's a lot more likely to talk about what she knows if we don't try to screw her over, that's for certain. I get the feeling she's going to have more errands for you people once you bring it back, too. Still dunno what's in it for me."
"Exotic drugs?" The hobgoblin laughs uproariously, jingling his tool kit.

Húxiān shares the laugh while hopping between a ruined column and wall. She reclines on top of the wall and swings her tail around in circles, making little dancing sparks of electricity that float harmlessly up into the air over the swamp before flashing out.

"Hey, that's a definite perk of this gang so far! I just mean, what does mother think I'm getting out of all this aside from 'almost eaten by dragons.'"

Heron was listening while patching himself up, and now that he's finally done, he stands up with a loud groan. His shield at his side, impeccably clean might catch some of the lights that break through the tree lines. 

"So it's decided then. We say our respects to our fallen Leaf, we take the Atrix Blossom, and we take the body of the Divine, and track our way back to the All Knowing Mother, and see what riddles she has for us."

Once situated at the hut, Quacksalver goes through his pockets, quietly handing out a few odds and ends. They'll only remain potent for the day, but he tries to hand a Numbing Tonic to Heron, a Soothing Tonic to Bereket, and a Silvertongue Mutagen to Húxiān. If asked, it's mostly so they can use their own discretion on when they might need such things. If observed closely... the hobgoblin runs tight on nearly carrying too much. If not given away, he's at least forced to bag some of these things.

Heron puts down the divine on the bed, as instructed, and goes to stand out of the way, with his hands folded against a wall. 
Heron tacks on "Daughter returned as well, fur intact" then quietly, very quietly. "mostly"
Berekit finds a window that will let him be part of the conversation.  "We also removed a young dragon from setting up a lair nearby."

"Tactful way of saying most of us almost choked to death on dragon poison."

The hob laughs approvingly.
Heron eyes narrow as he watches the scene from his spot. Something is afoot.

Quacksalver considers breakfast. Then he considers a smoke. Ultimately the smoke wins. He looks around the hut and seems to gauge the old woman. Holding up a hand rolled, he gives a quiet, "Pardon me." And steps outside without touching his food. As he lights up, he rejoins the conversation near Berekit at the window, but back a couple paces.

Húxiān sets about enjoying the food, eggs are apparently a rare event that she plans to make the most of. She seems a bit confused at everyone else's hesitation at first, then seems to disregard the thought and focus on eating.

After most of his current batch of flayleaf is gone, Quacksalver leans towards the window. The stuff smells potent enough to explain him taking it outside in nongoblin company. Clearly he's been listening. 

"We want what everyone wants. Which is to say, the best that's on offer at any given time. These fellows seemed to have some vague hope that their god in there might not be too dead to help. Though they can certainly correct me if I've read that wrong. I would like to be a part of whatever b

Berekit crosses his arms at the window.  "I apologize that I am unable to join you at the table due to my size.  But what you say has truth.  Heron and myself were there when Nith was freed from her prison.  Since then we have become pawns for the gods.  So information is our priority.  What can you tell us of Atrix?  What can you tell us of this family dispute with the gods.  What did you want the flower for? Can it be used.to resurrect Atrix?  These are just a few questions we have."

Heron looks to berekit, and assuming he sees no hesitation, will agree to the second. "Your second condition is doable. I'll welcome any good intentioned folk to helps us overcome the evil that is Nith M'aera. Your first one, however, will require an explanation."

The hobgoblin looks less thrilled about these conditions than Heron sounds.

"Not a Leech, myself...but battlefield doctrine applies here, I believe. To wit; a patient kept against their will is a prisoner. If she is a patient and not a carcass, the decision is hers, by right, regardless of our opinion. In her current condition, she obviously does not reject being here. Similarly, I see no reason Húxiān should not be welcome to travel with us if she wishes to."

The things he muses upon are most

Heron wants to chuckle at the boldness, but holds himself back. 
"Was our assumption was right. You'll use the flower to bring her back? But you'll do more than that."
"What do you think Cumeyr would think of these terms, Berekit? Should we summon him and ask?" Heron returns the stare.
Húxiān settles back and smolders with a quiet anger evident in her posture and visage.

Quacksalver snorts a bit. The set of his jaw suggests he heard a threat.

"Patient or prisoner? And please do not repeat yourself again. For my part I cannot accept those terms without clarification on that specific point."

"Nith already took care of my feet problem.  However before you kill us for insolence.  Can you swear that you do not plan on using her body parts for arcane or other concoctions for amplifying your own powers?  Atrix i feel tried to do what was right.  We just want to do right for her."

Húxiān stands as well and cries out with a rather primal barking scream. Shocks of static force arc off her body.

"This is ridiculous! None of you have any skill at communication or negotiation whatsoever, it's infuriating to watch."

She jabs a finger at the visitors.

"You've no respect at all, making demands of your host, and the only person who can help you with this. Mother's food is delicious, by the way, you'd know if you even touched it. If the god-thing is useful to mother, good. It is

From the window, Quacksalver tips his head. He seems to have interpreted all that as resolving his particular hang-up.

"So both things are ingredients? Might I help with the immortality serum, or what have you?"

Húxiān remains standing, and takes a moment to recompose herself before speaking.

"Mother. These folks want to know everything you can tell them about these..."

sigh

"...'Gods.' They fight among themselves and send these people around to do things for them. The blossom shares its name with one of them, so that too. The alchemist desires to work with it; We could have eaten it in the swamp, but brought it back in good faith.

"Eat or, uh, whatever we would need to do." she adds somewhat sheepi
Quacksalver comes back inside, seemingly content to be shown how not to butcher the rare bloom.

Heron's stare softens when the situation get diffused, and he lets out a breath. 
"Please forgive me, just two weeks ago the only magic that was known to me were the children's tales to scare kids into behaving, and the miracles of the divine, treated as the ultimate power. To let a body of the divine go, without even an explanation seemed like a failure of duty,  but an explanation was given, and I'll accept it."

Heron would nod, and would try to discreetly listen in to Quicksalver and the Mot
Berekit clears his throat before speaking once more. "Could you use the flower to resurrect the goddess?  Or did you have an alternate path for her?"

Húxiān recoils slightly at the concept.

"That seems like even more dead than normal dead would be."
Berekit uncrosses his arms.  "Thank you for the answer."

Heron, a little surprised at how forthcoming the Mother is, after the situation, so he prods a little further. 
"What are your opinions on the gods, and their "family" feud? You mentioned Cumeyr earlier like some dictator. Why?"

Heron looks to Berekit, then to Huxian, and with some hesitation pulls out the figurine. "He sent us on this quest, to find remnants of Nith M'aera Power, then use these figurines to summon him so he can lock her away again."

Heron tries to remain his composure during this, however hard that may be and continues his questions. 

"So your goal in all this, would be to send your daughter onto the front lines between these being powerful enough to be mistaken for gods, and try to gain an advantage in the chaos?"

Heron tenses a little "I'm only a backcountry son of a fisherman. Politeness and decorum does not come naturally to me. I mean no insults, you clearly have more knowledge in this war than I do, so I'm trying to gain perspective.

"He is correct.  We are soldiers that have been voluntold and thrust into this war as well.  Though you already do not believe it we are aware that this war has affected everyone in the world.  Given that everything changed 2 weeks ago.  So we do appreciate your forthrightness."

Quacksalver remains quiet for much of the talk about gods and their relationships. The spirits, sorcerers, or whatever they really are barely seem to interest him. A thread of conversation does catch his ear though. 

"Life is a war. Never doubt it a moment. We are all but soldiers upon a field, often being driven by forces we can scarcely understand."

"Sorry I kinda spaced out there. I figure we should make this potion or whatever as potent as it can get, right? Or we might all die, if I understand the stakes properly."

She frowns at Inda.

"What was that about trusting me? When did that start? Weren't you going to teach me how to do the big magic stuff? I'll go and save the world if I have to, it just feels like maybe we're horribly outmatched."
"Two weeks? Assuming everyone is willing to wait, what can you teach me in such a short time?"
Berekit mutters "it's not patience.
Húxiān settles back down to finish eating. Her eyes rest on the cauldron with anticipation.
Heron sighs, and finds a seat. "I would like to learn how to use some of the new herbs I've been noticing for healing poultices."

Heron looks up at her, a little defensively. "The village priest back home took me under his wing and thought me most of what he knew. I know how to patch up cuts and bruises and broken bones, less about long term illnesses and such, but that was before all this magic came to be."
"It seems the best option to except your wisdom and guidance."

Quacksalver spends the next couple weeks practicing with Inda's tools. His creations get sold for a modest living at the village. Their minor ailments get some professional attention while he's nearby. Leastways the diseases and injuries that he can treat.
Húxiān visits town multiple times over the week. She'd be spotted socializing and mingling around in the market when its active, and the taverns and inns when it's not.

Berekit will offer his aid to a few of the local tavern by hunting prey and or edible forage that they can use.  Then a few nights he will spend pouring over the 2 arcane scrolls left to ink them into his spellbook.
"Dragon's Maw sounds like a place you go to challenge a dragon." It's not a question. Merely an observation.
Berekit pulls out his formulae book and in the back writes down the locations.  "Do you have any idea what these sources may be or once we are closer what signs to look for?"
Húxiān listens with interest to the list of locations, but she shifts uncomfortably when Hwa-Lun gets mentioned.

Quacksalver looks to Heron and Berekit.

"You gents had destinations already in mind. How do these fit into what you already wanted to do?"
Heron simply shakes his head.
Heron looks at Inda, and sort of neutrally asks "Any dreams about powerful artifacts near Dyrena's Stitches?"

"Stealing power is even better, because then these god-things don't get to use it on us later!"

She wrinkles her nose, remembering how the encounter in the swamp went.

"Ehhh, but far more dangerous. Especially right now."

"Stealing is such accusatory language. Could we, perhaps, tactically acquire said power?"

The hobgoblin grins at the prospect.

Before leaving the home, Heron would have gone to the body of Atrix, and stood to speak a prayer over the body. Not one of mourning, or grief or bereavement, but one for luck. For a journey ahead. For a bright star to guide her home. Once outside, and once Inda waves the group off, Heron will adjust the shield on his arm, and turn to the group, a little more specifically to Berekit. "So do we continue on our task to help seal away Nith M'aera, or do we gather some more power first?"

The hob seems indifferent as always to the somewhat dead Atrix. Outside though, he seems eager in his own way to be off.

"You lot decide our course. You will have flasks to back up whatever you decide to do. If you fear that N'ith whatever, a dose of power could be a playing field leveler, though."

Out in the elements, he rolls and then lights another smoke. The pungent leaves seem to help him focus.

Húxiān waves goodbye cheerily and turns away to move quickly. After the door closes however, she stops and stares back at the hovel for a beat before catching up with the group.

"The Nith-thing is pretty scary. It sounds like we would be better of grabbin' some powerful stuff first, and then do whatever sealing away thing after."

Bereket moves back to the front of the cottage.  "I agree with you Huxian.  If we want to go after Nith we have to prepare. Atrix should be avenged however we are not in a position of power to do that.  So it would seem to me we follow the new path before us and revisit the other when we might have a greater chance of success."

Heron nods, looks ahead in a direction he believes to be right, and says "I hope you two are good with directions, because Leaf was like a compass and I don't think Berekit and I could have made it here without him"
You do know berekit is from a nomadic tribe and has survival...
The hobgoblin makes a fifty fifty gesture with one hand... but carries on as they walk in the direction of the pull. If needs be he can find True North. Probably. After a try or two.

Quacksalver eyes the smoke. Almost reflexively, he looks around nearer to where the party are. A hand stays close against his tools. In particular, he scans for movement. 

"Burning buildings usually indicate raiders of some sort..."

"What's even worth taking from people in a tiny place like this?"

Húxiān shifts nervously. Quieter, she questions,

"You don't think they're slavers?"
Hero says a quick prayer and speeds his pace up. "Whats the plan? Go straight in, or watch from the outskirts first? If there's any survivors waiting won't help them."

"In this case I rather assume the worst and hope for the best.  Until we get closer we will not know.  This could be a celebration and just a giant bonfire.  It may be best to approach and observe first and then make a plan of action.  It will not do for us to rush in to traps or certain death."

With a slight smile, Quacksalver carries on in the direction of the village. Not hurrying his pace, but not slowing either. He also seems to have no interest in sneaking up on buildings that are probably on fire.

"Celebration would reveal itself as soon as we get close. Perhaps not coincidentally, an ambush from slavers would likely do the same. Eyes up. Assume we are being watched. But I do like our chances if there happens to be trouble in there. Better to get close enough to tell, either way

Heron will throw his shield-arm back to dislodge some of the acid that's been thrown at him, and shouts at him "I've had coffees stronger than that!" before advancing forwards towards the orcs, straight into the fray. He'll try to go for a trip towards the orc that tried to throw a javelin. With a critical success, he'll point his gaff at the downed orc and shout "Quack! Turn his teeth to rubber!"

Húxiān drinks one of the vials Quacksalver had already prepared and runs to flank one of the orcs. She tosses the used vial aside and claws at the flanked orc with her now free hand, holding a wand offhand.

Berekit draws an arrow and knocks it to his bull and seeing the placement of the trouble makers will spellstrike a vomit swarm and arrow at the alchemist targeting all 3 enemies.   The arrow sinks into the alchemist and a swarm of scorpions and scarab beetles burst from the wound spilling out in a 3- foot cone narrowly avoiding heron.  Then he enters into arcane cascade.

Quacksalver looks over the situation at hand. Nodding, he mixes up a mutagen for himself. Immediately after downing it, his fingers sprout claws, and his already pointed teeth extend into something vicious looking. Grinning at his own self improvements, he approaches the orcs and their fox with measured but menacing steps.

Quacksalver rushes around to engage the other alchemist. Grunting through his newly grown fangs, he takes  a bite out of the fellow, ending him immediately. Realizing the threat of further thrown vials is over, he tosses a quickly processed batch of purple fear gas at the other orc. This seems to take some of the fight out him. In a slightly deeper timbre than usual, he grins to Heron.

"Was that the rubber teeth one? I forget."

Heron shrugs, both to the question and in trying to shake out the damage from the Commander and says "Eh, good enough" ignoring the fact that his fellow had just grown massive teeth and claws, he restarts his onslaught against the commander. He points his gaff behind the commander, to the orc that's missing a chunk of meat. "You're gonna be his next snack." 

Heron digs his heel into the ground, then puts his shield back up and says from behind "You gonna keep fighting, or you planning on runnin
Berekit holds his position concentrating to recharge his spellstrike before unleashing a gouging claw arrow at the fire fox. Striking the fox at the throat.

Húxiān tumbles south of the commander and grabs at his side. She step cleanly out from where he looks to find her and utilizes his momentary confusion to strike at his weakened guard. She manages to put out the fire, but the acid still burns.

Heron scowls at the fox biting his ankles, and tries to shoo it away using his gaff, when that fails, he uses the gaff to try to pin him to the ground. He'll then take unlatch the broken shield to give him some room to breathe and take out a bottle of something, and pour it over his ankle wound. 

Demoralize (sucess)
Trip (crit sucess)
Battle Medicine (crit Success)
Quacksalver preys upon the Commander's fear, stepping to to lash out with fang and claw. Caught between the party as he is, the orc should have trouble suppressing his terror.
Berekit concentrates to recharge his spell strike and continues shooting into the melee targeting the orc with this shot.  Just as the arrow digs in the shaft splits into 3 heads piecing the orc.
Húxiān manages to get the acid under control and uses her wand of healing to bolster everyone who got hit. She moves to the corner of a building and skulks around, watching for more orcs.

Quacksalver hands out restoratives. Lacking the time to properly rummage the other alchemist, he lets his current mutagen tick on. Joining the others where ever they opt to engage other next batch, he still has a trick or two in reserve.

Upon hearing the footfalls of the enemies, Heron hops over the wall and stalks towards the two orcs with only the crackling of wooden flames to cover his sounds. He approaches the orc and as he moves in he tries to trip one of them. He looks up from the downed orc and speaks "Try to douse me in one of those concoctions, I dare you" and raises his shield. 

Stride ( I assume some difficult terrarain but I should have plenty of movement hoping over that wall) 
Trip
Shielding Taunt
Húxiān steps lightly from the side and waves cheerily at the orcs. As she moves into the road, swipes of her tail launch bolts of voltaic foxfire at the prone orc.

Quacksalver lumbers towards the approaching orcs. Flashing a sharp toothed grin at the one now between himself and Hero, he takes a firm bite out of that fellow's shoulder. Claws flash but fail to find flesh. For his part the hobgoblin seems to be enjoying the fighting. Not in a bloodthirsty manner, but more...reveling in what his concoctions let him do.

Berekit standing by the tree and with the smoke from the nearby fires draws and fires at the nearest target.  Not seeing the alchemists in the distance.  He combines the gouging claw spell with his arrow and shoots the enemy.  Before recharging his spellstrike.

Grinning back at the orc that nailed him with a javelin, Quacksalver charges by to engage. He tosses a fast molotov at the rival alchemist. The flames only graze the fellow as he turns his claws on the one with the axe. No blood draw. Not yet. But he works the problem.

Heron rushes after the fleeing orc, but quickly changes targets when he see's Chase engage, and trips his target up. He points his gaff at the commander some distance away and shouts "COME ON THEN, JOIN THE FRAY! RAIDING IS MORE DIFFICULT WHEN THEY FIGHT BACK ISN'T IT!"
Berekit attempts to spellstrike the orc rushing closer but a cloud of smoke and ash throws his aim off.  He rechannels his spellstrike once more.  "I will need more arrows soon."

Húxiān follows after the orc alchemist and calls over to Berekit in a casual tone.

"Just as well you missed, I want to talk to this one!"

She utilizes the orc's distraction to strike them painfully in the kidney with a closed fist.

Battle medicine
Trip (crit success)
Shielding Taunt

Heron sees Quack getting flanked, and quickly readjusts  his position to help quack block the damage from the attacks. He takes out a torniquet and quickly wraps it around Quack's injury, then turns to face an orc and with a sweeping swing he'll go for the legs. In an act of disrespect, he'll just spit some blood on the downed orc.

Surprised, but grinning as Heron takes a nasty blow, and then turns around and treats him medically, the hobgoblin flings a vial of purple gas into the Commander's face. Roaring through the gas, he charges the other alchemist, clawing the fellow in the throat as he gets a whiff of the fear toxin. Voice sounding a little rough from the mutagen, he rumbles,

"If you want to question one, a knock to the head might be in order."
"Oh, okay." Húxiān steps over to the prone orc and being punching as instructed.

Berekit seeing Huxian start to soften one up for interrogation.  Turns to aim at the orc by Quacksalver.  As he shoots he coughs over the smoke blowing in his face missing his shot.  He then rechannels his spellstrike.

Berekit steadies his nerves and yells at Quack, "Get out of there."  Then channels another spell strike at the orc and as the arrow hits the orc the shaft seems to splinter as it drives another part of it into the orc making the wound deeper. Then he calls upon the stars to guide his future shots as he casts shooting star marking the orc and sinking in a second arrow which recharges his spellstrike.

Quacksalver takes a wild bite at the orc. Grunting as he doesn't make contact, he closes his eyes for a moment. The fangs and claws retract, and some of his wounds close. Realizing the sense in removing himself from range of that club, he moves back from the commander a ways.

From where she's standing, Húxiān whips a bolt of electric foxfire at the commander. She follows up with a whispered invocation that causes the foxfire to erratically fly around the commander, shocking him with more lightning.

Húxiān curses under her breath as she tries to get her fire out.

"Should have learned that water spell, damn it."
Once the fire is out though, Húxiān is going to break off from the party a little to look for survivors.

Berekit watches as Huxian moves away from the prisoner we took captive then back to Heron.  "You may want to hog tie him before he regains his senses."  Berekit slings his  bow  and will also start looking for any survivors or stragglers.

Quacksalver seems to have immediate objections. A tonic to help mend himself from the bruises. And immediately afterwards, the pockets of the orcs. Anything and everything they have of value is getting field stripped.
